items.text: While #Raiders RB Mike Washington, Jr. (foot/back) did NOT practice Thursday, TE Brock Bowers (hamstring/calf) was a FULL participant
items.why: The Raiders' Thursday injury report downgrades rookie RB Mike Washington Jr. from limited Wednesday to a non-participant Thursday with foot and back injuries.
items.implication: Washington's Week 7 availability vs. LAR is now in more doubt; Friday's practice and game designation are the checkpoint.
items.opportunity: Watch Friday's Raiders practice report and Washington's designation.

items.text: #Eagles Practice Report for Thursday: DNP ... WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle).
items.priorStatus: Not spotted at practice Thursday (reason not given)
items.newStatus: Did not practice Thursday (ankle), official report
items.why: The Eagles' first official practice report of the week lists WR Dontayvion Wicks as a non-participant with an ankle injury, confirming why he was not seen at practice.
items.implication: Philadelphia plays Monday vs. DAL, so Friday and Saturday reports decide Wicks' status; the Eagles' top three receivers by yards (Smith, Wicks, Goedert) all sat Thursday.
items.opportunity: Watch Friday's Eagles practice report for Wicks' participation.

items.text: Another full Eagles injury report. Devonta Smith DNP with a hamstring. Wicks listed with an ankle.
items.priorStatus: Not seen at practice Thursday (reason not given)
items.newStatus: Did not practice Thursday (hamstring), official report
items.why: The Eagles' official Thursday report lists WR DeVonta Smith as a non-participant with a hamstring injury.
items.implication: If Smith misses Monday's game, Eagles receiver snaps and targets shift to the remaining wideouts; watch who practices fully Friday.
items.opportunity: Watch Friday's report and any coach comments on Eagles WR roles.

items.text: #Eagles Practice Report for Thursday: DNP ... TE Dallas Goedert (knee).
items.priorStatus: Not spotted at practice Thursday (reason not given)
items.newStatus: Did not practice Thursday (knee), official report
items.why: The Eagles' official Thursday report lists TE Dallas Goedert as a non-participant with a knee injury; he missed Weeks 3 and 4 with a knee injury (Olivia Reiner notes it is unclear if it is the same one).
items.implication: If Goedert sits Monday, the Eagles' backup tight end inherits the starting role; Friday's report is the checkpoint.
items.opportunity: Watch Friday's report and Eagles TE depth comments.

items.text: #Falcons injury report for Thursday, and it is a lengthy one
items.why: The Falcons' Thursday injury report, posted by ESPN beat Marc Raimondi, downgrades RB Brian Robinson Jr. from limited Wednesday to a non-participant Thursday with a hamstring injury.
items.implication: Robinson's Week 7 availability vs. SF is in doubt; Friday's report and designation decide it. If he sits, Bijan Robinson's workload likely grows and Atlanta has only two running backs on the active roster (Jam Miller and Khalil Herbert are on the practice squad).
items.opportunity: Watch Friday's practice report, Robinson's game designation, and any practice-squad RB elevation.

items.text: Jets injury report: RB Breece Hall returns to practice, first time since quad injury in Week 3. He was limited. #Jets
items.newStatus: Officially limited on Thursday's injury report
items.why: The Jets' official Thursday report lists Breece Hall as a limited participant, his first practice since the Week 3 quad injury, upgrading Wednesday's DNP.
items.implication: Hall's Week 7 availability vs. MIA is trending up but not settled; Friday's participation and game designation decide it. Braelon Allen remains the next back if Hall is held out.
items.opportunity: Watch Friday's practice report and final designation for Hall.

items.text: Others not spotted at Eagles practice Thursday beyond DeVonta Smith: Dallas Goedert, Willie Lampkin, Nolan Smith, Dontayvion Wicks
items.newStatus: Not spotted at Eagles practice Thursday (reason not given)
items.why: Eagles beat reporter Tim McManus did not see Dontayvion Wicks at Thursday's practice; no reason was given.
items.implication: Wicks's Week 7 status is unclear until the Eagles' official Thursday report and Friday designations.
items.opportunity: Check the Eagles' official injury report for Wicks's listed participation and reason.

items.text: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) is back at practice. Did not see DeVonta Smith.
items.newStatus: Not seen at Eagles practice Thursday (reason not given)
items.why: Tim McManus did not see DeVonta Smith at Thursday's practice; Dallas Goedert was also not spotted. No reason was given.
items.implication: If Smith misses time, his receiver snaps would shift to the Eagles' next wideouts. Nothing official yet; Wicks was also not spotted Thursday.
items.opportunity: Watch the official Eagles report and Friday designations for Smith and Goedert.

items.text: 'Woody will get a good amount of carries, we have faith in Dare. Lot of faith in Woody.' #Texans OC Nick Caley on Woody Marks RB1 and Dare Ogunbowale RB2 vs. #Giants
items.priorStatus: Montgomery lead back; expected out W7 (groin)
items.newStatus: Woody Marks RB1, Dare Ogunbowale RB2 vs. NYG per OC Nick Caley
items.why: Texans beat reporter Aaron Wilson relays OC Nick Caley naming Marks the lead back and Ogunbowale the No. 2 for Week 7 with David Montgomery expected out; Underdog NFL relays the quote.
items.implication: With Montgomery expected to miss Week 7, Houston's carries are expected to go mainly to Woody Marks, with Dare Ogunbowale behind him. Montgomery is not yet officially ruled out.
items.opportunity: Watch Friday's designation for Montgomery and Week 7 backfield snap share between Marks and Ogunbowale.

items.text: Breece Hall is moving well at practice. I'd be optimistic about him playing. We'll know more tomorrow.
items.newStatus: PRACTICING_THU (official participation level pending); optimistic to play per Costello
items.why: Jets beat reporter Brian Costello watched Hall work Thursday after a Wednesday DNP; Yahoo Fantasy and SNY Jets also show him on the field. Late capture: posted before the 1:20 PM ET pass but not itemized then.
items.implication: Hall's Week 7 availability vs. MIA moves toward likely; if he plays, Braelon Allen's projected workload shrinks. Not official until the Thursday report and Friday designation.
items.opportunity: Watch the official Thursday participation level and Friday designation for Hall.

items.text: #Texans not practicing today: David Montgomery (groin), Jalen Pitre (AC shoulder sprain), Reed Blankenship (concussion protocol) and all are expected to miss Sunday game vs. #Giants
items.why: Texans beat reporter Aaron Wilson reports a second straight DNP and an expected absence; relayed by RotoWire, Underdog NFL and Yahoo Fantasy.
items.implication: Houston's lead back is expected to miss Week 7, so backfield work shifts to the other Texans backs vs. NYG. Not official until Friday.
items.opportunity: Watch the Friday designation and which Texans back leads practice reps.

items.text: The #Seahawks have activated RB Zach Charbonnet from the PUP list, a significant move.
items.why: Rapoport, Schefter and Garafolo all report the activation; Aaron Wilson relays the transaction alongside the Arroyo IR move.
items.implication: Seattle's backfield adds Charbonnet back for Week 7 vs. KC; his share in his first game back is unknown.
items.opportunity: Watch Seattle's Friday report and coach comments on how the backfield work will be split.

items.text: Source: Seahawks TE Elijah Arroyo is undergoing shoulder surgery today and will miss the rest of the season.
items.why: Schefter source report; Underdog NFL relay; Aaron Wilson reports the IR placement.
items.implication: Seattle loses a tight end for the season, which opens his snaps and targets to the remaining Seahawks tight ends.
items.opportunity: Watch Seattle's tight end usage in Week 7 vs. KC.

items.text: The current expectation is that the Cardinals will be without rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) this week against the Broncos, sources tell CBS Sports. Love missed last week's game vs. the Rams.
items.priorStatus: Ankle; missed Week 6; did not practice Wednesday, day to day per Mike LaFleur
items.why: Sourced report from Matt Zenitz (CBS Sports), relayed by RotoWire and Underdog NFL. Would be Love's second straight missed game.
items.implication: Arizona's lead back is expected to miss a second straight game, so the Week 6 backfield arrangement likely carries into Week 7 vs. DEN. Not official until the Friday injury report.
items.opportunity: Watch Thursday/Friday practice and the Friday designation, and which Cardinals back led the backfield in Week 6.

items.text: Raiders RB Mike Washington Jr. (foot/back) was listed as a limited participant on Wednesday's practice report.
items.priorStatus: No injury designation noted in prior passes
items.why: Official Raiders Wednesday practice report (via NFL Network's Around The NFL, relayed by RotoWire). First appearance of a foot/back issue for Washington in Pulse passes. Raiders TE Brock Bowers (hamstring/calf) was also limited.
items.implication: A new injury listing for a JD bench back; Thursday and Friday participation will show whether it affects his Week 7 availability vs. LAR.
items.opportunity: Watch Thursday/Friday participation and any Raiders RB usage comments.

items.text: RB Jonah Coleman had his 21-day window to return from IR opened and was present during viewing period.
items.why: The Broncos opened rookie RB Jonah Coleman's 21-day practice window Wednesday and he was on the field (Nick Kosmider; also UnderdogNFL, Chris Tomasson, Zac Stevens, RotoWire). Coleman has been out since a Week 2 high ankle sprain. Separately, Broncos RB Tyler Badie (thumb) did not practice Wednesday. Practice participation level comes with the official report. Adam Schefter confirmed the Broncos designated Coleman for return from injured reserve. Official Wednesday report: Coleman (ankle) was a full participant (UnderdogNFL).
items.implication: A returning rookie back could re-enter the Denver RB rotation once activated, which could change the backfield split.
items.opportunity: Possible Denver backfield role change; watch practice participation, activation timing and Sean Payton comments on his role.

items.text: RB Breece Hall (quad) won't practice today, but he will be evaluated as the week goes on, per Glenn. So it sounds like there's a chance.
items.why: Head coach Aaron Glenn said Hall will not practice Wednesday and will be evaluated as the week goes on; he did not rule Hall out for Sunday vs. Miami. Glenn on the RB room once Hall returns: 'Breece is our starter, he's always been our starter, but Braelon is going to get touches too.' Cimini at Wednesday practice: no sign of Breece Hall, not even in the rehab area.
items.implication: Hall's Week 7 availability is uncertain. If he can't go, Braelon Allen is the next Jets back in line for early-down work.
items.opportunity: Thursday and Friday practice participation and the Friday injury designation decide Hall's status; Allen's role grows only if Hall sits.

items.text: #Browns Todd Monken is optimistic that both Quinshon Judkins and Dylan Sampson will face the #Titans on Sunday.
items.priorStatus: Sampson IR stash, return timing TBD; Judkins nearing return (radio, Tue)
items.why: Head coach Todd Monken said Wednesday he is optimistic both Browns backs play Sunday vs. Tennessee. This upgrades Tuesday's radio-only expectation, which was held below floor. Browns listed Quinshon Judkins (ankle) and Dylan Sampson (knee) as limited participants Wednesday (UnderdogNFL; RotoWire via Akron Beacon Journal). Thu 12:17 PM ET: Browns OC Travis Switzer said it's "huge" to have Judkins (ankle) and Sampson (knee) both back this week vs. the Titans to provide a one-two punch (Mary Kay Cabot).
items.implication: Both could be back for Week 7, which would split the Browns backfield between them. Neither is officially cleared yet; practice reports will show it.
items.opportunity: Watch Wednesday-Friday practice participation and any IR activation move for Sampson before Sunday.

items.text: Source: The Giants plan to start J.J. McCarthy on Sunday vs. Houston.
items.priorStatus: Winston vs. McCarthy Week 7 decision pending
items.why: ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reports, citing a source, that the Giants plan to start McCarthy over Winston Sunday vs. Houston. No official team announcement yet. Harbaugh confirmed Wednesday: "We will be starting J.J. (McCarthy) in the game" vs. Texans; Jameis Winston is the backup (Jordan Raanan; also Schefter, Garafolo, Rapoport). Harbaugh added that starting McCarthy is the plan going forward (PFT). McCarthy stayed after Wednesday practice for extra work with his starting receivers, including Malik Nabers (Jordan Raanan). Raanan: McCarthy is the Giants starting quarterback for the foreseeable future; Harbaugh met with the QBs one-on-one Tuesday.
items.implication: Backup QB promoted to the starting job, which shifts the Giants passing game outlook to McCarthy for Week 7.
items.opportunity: QB role change on a team-wide basis; confirm with the Giants' official announcement or head coach comments.

items.text: Saints GM Mickey Loomis said WR Jordyn Tyson (hamstring, IR) is improving and 'getting closer' but will not practice this week.
items.priorStatus: IR (return window possible as soon as Oct 21)
items.why: GM statement Wednesday, confirmed by the official Saints account and Schefter. Tyson has not played a snap this season; no practice window opens this week.
items.implication: Tyson cannot be activated for Week 7, so the Saints WR rotation Vele has been working in stays without him this week. Dwain McFarland noted Tyson's return would cut into Vele's targets, so that risk is pushed back at least a week.
items.opportunity: Vele's current WR role is unchanged for Week 7; Tyson's earliest return now looks like Week 8 or later.

items.text: 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan said WR Christian Kirk (calf, IR) is a possibility to play in Week 7 at ATL; he does not think WR Demarcus Robinson will be ready to come off IR.
items.why: Head coach comment in MNF postgame presser (Mon night). No official activation or practice window yet. Update Wed 10-21: Kirk (calf) was listed as a full participant on the 49ers' Wednesday report, his first full participation this season (Nick Wagoner, ESPN; Harrison Rich). The session was a walkthrough after the Monday game, so participation was estimated. He remains on IR until activated.
items.implication: Kirk could rejoin a thin SF WR room (Evans Achilles tendinitis, Deebo Samuel hamstring) for Week 7 at ATL; first confirmation would be a practice-window opening and Wed/Thu participation.
items.opportunity: If activated, immediate target opportunity in an SF passing game missing multiple WRs.

items.text: Shanahan on Mike Evans: same Achilles issue that bothered him all week, acted up during MNF; called it Achilles tendinitis, not a long-term thing, no further testing believed needed. Week 7 availability at ATL unclear (PFT: hopeful he can play Sunday).
items.why: Head coach postgame comments; supersedes Monday-night aggravated-Achilles item with severity unknown. Evans (Achilles, ribs) did not practice Wednesday, as expected (Matt Barrows; also Nick Wagoner).
items.implication: Serious injury appears avoided, but Evans did not practice all last week and Week 7 status is uncertain; watch Wed practice participation.
items.opportunity: If Evans is limited or out, SF targets shift toward McCaffrey/Kittle and any returning WR (Christian Kirk).

items.text: Commanders HC Dan Quinn said WR Terry McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon (MRI Tuesday) and will miss the rest of the season. Team account confirmed the season-ending injury.
items.why: Head coach confirmation after the MRI, posted by the Commanders and the WAS beat; resolves the Monday-night UNCONFIRMED_HIGH_PRIORITY item (same event, superseded).
items.implication: Washington loses its WR1 for the season. WAS is on a Week 7 bye, so the WR target share is redistributed from Week 8; no coach has named who moves into the lead WR role yet. Watch for an IR move, a WR addition, and post-bye depth chart.
items.opportunity: Season-long vacated WR1 target share in Washington from Week 8.

items.text: 49ers WR routes on 34 Brock Purdy dropbacks in MNF Week 6 vs WAS: Jordan Watkins 31, Brandin Cooks 16, Mike Evans 16 (left early, heel), Jacob Cowing 11, Malik Turner 1. Deebo Samuel, Christian Kirk, Ricky Pearsall, Demarcus Robinson and De'Zhaun Stribling were all out injured.
items.why: Player-specific route participation from MNF (91% of dropbacks) with five SF WRs injured; usage data, not a depth-chart announcement. Wednesday: Mike Evans (Achilles) and Deebo Samuel (hamstring) did not practice (Nick Wagoner, Shanahan's practice plan).
items.implication: Watkins was SF's only near-every-down WR on MNF. Week 7 role depends on Evans (Achilles/heel) and Kirk (calf, IR, possible return) status; a Kirk activation would compete for the same routes.
items.opportunity: Near-full-time route share in a depleted SF WR room heading into Week 7 at ATL.

items.text: The Giants are releasing RB Najee Harris. Harris was named the Week 6 starter vs. New Orleans but had 4 carries for 2 yards; he has 31 carries for 99 yards (3.2 per carry) this season. It follows his public frustration with John Harbaugh's four-back rotation.
items.why: Starter in a four-back rotation removed from the roster; the Giants backfield goes from four backs to three heading into Week 7.
items.implication: Harris's carries move to the remaining Giants backs. No coach has named a lead back yet; watch Wednesday practice and Harbaugh comments for who gets the bigger share.
items.opportunity: Fewer backs splitting Giants carries; possible role growth for the remaining NYG RBs.
supportingSources: Dan Duggan (The Athletic, snap-count note on the four-back rotation)

items.text: Texans are waiving LB Jamal Hill from the 53-man roster to open a roster spot for the pending activation of WR Tank Dell, per a league source.
items.why: HOU beat roster-move report: the Texans are clearing a 53-man spot specifically for Dell's activation, the step before he is officially added back. DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Dell will play in Week 7. Aaron Wilson: Tank Dell back on the practice field Wednesday. DeMeco Ryans on Tank Dell's return: excited for Sunday to see him run out of the tunnel (Aaron Wilson).
items.implication: Dell is on track to rejoin the Houston WR rotation for Week 7 after his long injury absence; the official activation would confirm it. His snap and route share on return is not yet known.
items.opportunity: A returning WR who could move back into a regular role in the Houston passing game from Week 7.

items.text: Eagles waived RB Jaydon Blue and placed RB Carson Steele on waived/injured, and signed RB Elijah Mitchell to the practice squad. That leaves Saquon Barkley and Dameon Pierce as the only running backs on the 53-man roster.
items.why: PHI beat and national reports of official roster moves. Pierce was elevated to carry the workload in Week 6 with Barkley out; with Blue and Steele gone he is now the only other running back on the active roster. Barkley's Week 7 status has not been announced.
items.implication: Pierce is the clear No. 2 back in Philadelphia, and the lead back if Barkley misses Week 7 against Dallas. Field Yates reads the thin room as a sign Barkley may be back for Week 7; that is analyst inference, not a team statement.
items.opportunity: Backup promoted to sole RB2, with lead-back carries if Barkley is out.

items.text: The Bucs are game planning as if Jalon Daniels will start Sunday at Carolina. Baker Mayfield (dislocated thumb) will practice Wednesday for the first time since the injury, and the team moved its weekly QB media availability to Thursday.
items.why: TB beat report, matching Greg Auman's account of Todd Bowles saying the team will plan initially on Daniels starting while it evaluates Mayfield. Mayfield returns to practice Wednesday; no final Week 7 decision yet. Bowles expects to decide on Mayfield Friday; Mayfield threw well Wednesday and the QBs split reps (Jenna Laine; also PFT). Buccaneers listed Baker Mayfield (right thumb) as a full participant Wednesday (Schefter; also UnderdogNFL). Bowles still expects to decide Friday.
items.implication: Daniels is the working Week 7 starter against Carolina unless Mayfield's thumb progresses this week. Thursday's QB availability is the next checkpoint.
items.opportunity: Backup QB in line to start Week 7; role depends on Mayfield's Wednesday/Thursday practice.
